Work out the state of every Load Data wizard step

Source: R/wizard-step_status.R
compute_step_states.Rd

Applies the step definitions to a dataset and returns, for each step, whether it is complete, locked, required and how it should show in the wizard's row of steps. The wizard's row of steps, its footer and the summary page all read this result.

Usage

compute_step_states(
  cd,
  current,
  requires_walkthrough = TRUE,
  step_defs = wizard_step_defs,
  acknowledged = character(0)
)

Arguments

cd

The dataset, a CacheConnection object (the value of cache(), not the reactive), or NULL when no dataset is loaded.

current

The key of the step the user is on, a string, or NULL when there is none.

requires_walkthrough

TRUE (the default) when the steps must be gone through in order, as for a newly loaded Excel or Stata file. FALSE for a finished dataset, which locks nothing.

step_defs

The steps, a list with the structure of wizard_step_defs, which is the default. A step may also have a required_fn, a function of the dataset that is used in place of its required value.

acknowledged

The keys of the steps the user has moved on from with Continue or Skip, a character vector.

Value

A list with one element per step, in the order of step_defs. Each element is a list with:

  • key, title_key: copied from the step's definition.

  • status: "locked", "current", "complete" or "available" (see Details).

  • complete: TRUE when the step's complete_fn returns TRUE for cd.

  • touched: the result of the step's touched_fn, or the same as complete when the step has none.

  • locked: TRUE when the user may not open the step yet.

  • relevant: the result of the step's relevant_fn, or TRUE when the step has none.

  • required: TRUE when the step must be complete before the user can go on.

Details

On a walkthrough (requires_walkthrough = TRUE) a step is locked when the step before it is not in acknowledged, or when any earlier required step is incomplete. Without a walkthrough nothing is locked.

status is only for display. It is "locked" for a locked step, otherwise "current" for the step named by current, otherwise "complete" when the step is complete, touched and in acknowledged, and otherwise "available". To know whether a step's data is done, read complete, not status: the current step never has the status "complete".

Examples

old <- options(cd2030.wizard = list(national_rates_groups = list(
  cd_wizard_field_group("title_upload_group_maternal", "sub_upload_group_maternal",
    cd_wizard_survey_field("anc4_prop", "anc4", "title_upload_anc4_survey"),
    cd_wizard_national_rate_fields()
  )
)))
cache <- load_cache_data(system.file("extdata", "kenya.xlsx", package = "cd2030.core"))
#> ℹ Loading Excel "kenya.xlsx" for parts
#> ! The following columns are empty: anc_1trimester, under5_deaths, total_deaths,
#>   ipv2, measles_cases
#> ℹ Successfully loaded and cleaned data
#> ℹ Auto-detect candidates (|group|): vaccine=19, rmncah=28 -> selected rmncah

# on a walkthrough, with the first two steps passed
states <- compute_step_states(cache,
  current = "survey_files", acknowledged = c("upload", "quality")
)
vapply(states, function(s) s$status, character(1))
#> [1] "complete" "complete" "current"  "locked"   "locked"   "locked"   "locked"  

# a finished dataset: nothing is locked
states <- compute_step_states(cache, current = NULL, requires_walkthrough = FALSE)
vapply(states, function(s) s$complete, logical(1))
#> [1]  TRUE  TRUE FALSE FALSE  TRUE FALSE FALSE

options(old)
